_meta.title: FL3 strategy leaderboard v2 — proper-score ranking (RETROSPECTIVE, not prospective)
_meta.governance: R010: backtest-origin numbers may not appear on the prospective leaderboard. Games scored here were all played before this ranking was computed.
_meta.benchmark: coin flip p=0.5 for the home club
_meta.score: Brier, lower is better; skill = 1 - Brier/Brier(coin)
_meta.demotion_rule: DEMOTED_TO_PAPER unless Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 and the 2.5% cluster lower bound is > 0.0
_meta.roi_policy: PD-01 — no licensed price is held, so ROI is UNAVAILABLE for every strategy. It is never reported as zero.
_meta.why_not_win_rate: Win rate ignores confidence and drops ties; a strategy that says 0.51 every week and one that says 0.99 are indistinguishable to it.

what_would_change_our_mind: A cluster lower bound that stays above zero on games the strategy did not see when it was fitted (a second season).
The same sign of skill on a different scoring rule (log loss), so the result is not an artefact of Brier.
what_would_falsify_it: A bootstrap interval that includes zero once a second season is added.
Skill that flips sign between Weeks 5-7 and Weeks 8-10.
